recognitionRules: Use a pencil-and-paper cover with a quiet text field.
Pair Trebuchet headings with Arial instructional detail.
Use violet and pale lavender with lime reserved for focused learning cues.
Show the lesson map and success criteria before practice.
Keep alternative response modes visible alongside the task.

quote: Try the task. Name the choice. Explain the reason.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use A TASK TO TRY in Trebuchet with a short pencil-like diagonal stroke outside the wordmark. No graduation cap or achievement badge.
invariants: Use a pencil-and-paper cover with a quiet text field.
Pair Trebuchet headings with Arial instructional detail.
Use violet and pale lavender with lime reserved for focused learning cues.
adaptations: A short demonstration retains task, example and check.
Participant sheets remove presenter navigation while preserving success criteria.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
